title: Case 034: Returned parcel has reached the carrier depot but not the merchant warehouse

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: The return is in carrier transit, with no merchant receipt. Tracing should end in a warehouse confirmation rather than an inferred refund.
initial_request: My return has been sitting at the depot. Could you trace it to the merchant? I need to know when they actually have it.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Ask the carrier's returns team to trace the parcel to the merchant.
next_action.recipient: Returns trace team, Plover Arc Logistics

outcome: The merchant warehouse confirms physical receipt; refund approval remains separate.
boundaries: Merchant physical receipt does not establish accepted condition, refund approval or payment.

events.body: RT-034 last scan: return depot, 2026-03-07 07:40 UTC. No merchant receiving scan is visible. The carrier still holds the return.

events.body: Please trace RT-034 through to merchant receipt. Ask the merchant receiving team to confirm physical acceptance rather than use a departure scan as proof.
RT-034 physically received at our returns bay at 12:50 UTC on 2026-03-08. Inline receipt WH-034 records one return carton for TG-034. Inspection and refund decisions are still pending.
